field_meaning.hi: Layer के क्षतिग्रस्त हिस्सों को भरना।

review_objections: Alibaba: The Hindi description says 'Layer ke kshitigrast hisson ko bharna' (filling damaged parts of a layer). Inpainting fills missing or unwanted parts of an image, not necessarily 'damaged' parts of a layer. The topic 'layers' is incorrect; it's a general image processing technique.
